annotations.title: Start tracking metrics from the starting catalog

description: Creates the named presets as real metrics the workspace owns, tagged from the catalog. Safe to repeat: a preset the workspace already has comes back `already_present` rather than creating a second series, and a workspace's own renames and targets are never overwritten. Adopt only what the user agreed to — a metric nobody reads is noise on the Metrics tab, and eight thoughtful ones beat forty. Tell them the metrics start empty and the next step is a feed (ledger_feeds_create) or a first reading. May return `needs_confirmation`.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Ignored for workspace API keys.
